title: Forecrew verification report
description: The report column of verification_reports (data-model.md): the verification of one PR head (change and sha), built by forecrewd from the stored test runs, the task's acceptance criteria, the test engineer's test map and the fail-on-base check. It is rendered as the forecrew/verification check run and a PR comment. Any entry in blocking blocks the merge.

testID.description: A test as <classname>::<name>, or <name> when the report has no classname.

status.description: passed: nothing blocks. failed: something in blocking. incomplete: required cells have no result yet.

results.description: One entry per environment, cell and suite: the latest attempt's test run.

required.description: Whether a failure here blocks: a required cell and a required suite.

status.description: The test run status, or missing when the cell has no result yet.

job.description: Ref of the command job, e.g. JOB-41.

attempts.description: Test runs of this cell and suite for the sha (reruns included).

criteria.description: Acceptance criterion id (e.g. AC-1) -> its tests and status. untested: no test covers it, which blocks unless untestable gives a reason.

tests.description: Test -> its worst result over the required results.

untestable.description: Why the criterion cannot be tested automatically, when so.

new_tests.description: Test added by the change -> whether it failed on the base branch. A new test that passed on base blocks.

flaky.description: Tests that failed and then passed in a rerun of the same cell; listed, not blocking.

environments.description: Environment name -> tool versions reported by its jobs (tool -> version output).

blocking.description: Human-readable reasons the merge is blocked, e.g. "AC-2 has no test". Empty when status is passed.
